item.title: Self-Hosted JWT Authentication Libraries: PyJWT vs jsonwebtoken vs jose vs jjwt vs golang-jwt
item.description: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) are the backbone of modern API authentication. Every microservice, mobile app, and single-page application relies on JWTs for stateless session management, OAuth 2.0 token exchange, and API key validation. But the quality and security of JWT libraries varies dramatically across languages. This guide compares five leading open source JWT libraries — PyJWT (Python), jsonwebtoken (Node.js), jose (TypeScript/universal), jjwt (Java), and golang-jwt (Go) — on security defaults, algorithm support, performance, and self-hosted deployment patterns.
